name: souschef
title: Sous Chef
description: A chef's CV hung on the pass: black enamel and steel ticket rails, with every role printed as a narrow kitchen docket in black and red, slid up under the rail's lip and torn off at a saw-tooth foot, three to a row on A4.

tokens.--font-mono: the kitchen-printer typeface: every docket, the menu, labels, contact lines, buttons, tags, code and the footer
tokens.--font-cond: the condensed sans for names, page titles, the station on each docket and running text
tokens.--text-xs: smallest text: docket header lines, the location strip, labels, buttons and the footer
tokens.--text-s: small text: the menu, contact lines, the headline under the name
tokens.--text-l: the opening line of a page, small headings and note titles
tokens.--text-xl: the name in the profile band and headings inside a page
tokens.--text-xxl: page titles and the name at the head of the CV
tokens.--text-docket: the printed text on a docket: summary and highlights
tokens.--text-station: the double-height capitals of the role title on a docket
tokens.--leading: space between lines of running text
tokens.--color-bg: the wall behind everything: black enamel, or the white day wall in the light scheme
tokens.--color-text: text on the wall: page titles and running text
tokens.--color-muted: quieter text on the wall: labels, dates, the CV headline, the print note and the footer
tokens.--color-accent: links and buttons on the wall, list markers, the skills separators, the quote bar and the print button's border
tokens.--color-rule: dashed and solid dividing lines on the wall, and table rules
tokens.--color-enamel: the black enamel band at the top of every page, and the pass behind the headline and rails of the home page, in both schemes
tokens.--color-enamel-text: text and links on the enamel: the menu, the name, the contact lines and the home page's headline
tokens.--color-enamel-muted: the quieter text on the enamel (the headline under the name, the label over the home page's rails), its dashed divider and the menu hover mark
tokens.--color-signal: ribbon red that holds on every ground: the current menu mark, contact-link underlines, the border and hover fill of the ticket buttons, the red line of the docket mark in the menu bar, and focus rings
tokens.--color-paper: the bond-white docket paper in both schemes, also the docket in the menu bar's mark, the text of the location strip and the skip link's ground
tokens.--color-print: the black printer ink on a docket, its dashed rules, the location strip, the ink line of the menu bar's mark and the skip link
tokens.--color-print-soft: the grey print of the period on a docket
tokens.--color-print-red: the red printer ink on a docket: highlights and the underline of a linked title
tokens.--color-keyline: the printer-grey edge of each docket and its torn foot, and the tag outlines
tokens.--color-steel-hi: the bright top edge of the steel ticket rail and the edge where its lip turns under
tokens.--color-steel: the flat face of the steel rail, the rail of the menu bar's mark, and the steel rules under the band, under the home page's pass and above the footer
tokens.--color-steel-lo: the dark lower lip of the steel rail that the dockets slide up behind
tokens.--color-shadow: the shadow a rail casts on the wall and on the paper under its lip, and the shadow under a docket
tokens.--color-code-bg: background of code in page text
tokens.--measure: longest comfortable line of running text
tokens.--gutter: the side margin of the page
tokens.--docket-width: narrowest a docket gets on the home page's rails, which hang as many across as fit
tokens.--rail-height: height of the steel ticket rail, face and lip together
tokens.--tooth: depth of the saw-tooth tear at the foot of a docket
tokens.--radius: corner rounding of buttons, tags and code (small: steel and paper have square edges)
